classes.native: Runs on Databricks Free Edition serverless with little or no change.
classes.adapted: Needs changes such as volume paths instead of local or DBFS paths, a file or rate source instead of Kafka, or removing RDD, sparkContext, cache or spark.master settings.
classes.alt_env: Needs an environment outside the Free Edition browser workspace, such as a Kafka broker, Databricks CLI, VS Code, CI/CD or an external Git provider.

classification_status: preliminary, unverified against Free Edition limits

summary: Serverless compute only; custom compute configurations are not supported.
Outbound internet access is limited to a set of trusted domains.
One SQL warehouse (2X-Small), max 5 concurrent job tasks, one active pipeline per pipeline type.
R and Scala are not supported; custom workspace storage locations are not supported.
One workspace and one metastore per account; no account console or account-level APIs; no SSO or SCIM.
Usage quotas apply; exceeding them shuts compute down for the rest of the day.
Non-commercial use only; no SLA or support.
